title.en: Find a Battery at the Repair Station

brief.zh: 先亲手找出指定电量的电池，再看程序怎样逐块找，又怎样利用排好的顺序缩小范围。
brief.en: Find a battery with the requested charge, then see how a program searches one by one and how a sorted row helps it narrow the search.

concept.zh: 逐块查找、折半查找与比较次数
concept.en: Linear search, binary search, and counting comparisons

title.en: Check one battery at a time

body.zh: 每查看一块电池，就把它的电量和目标比一次。找到就停。电池可以按任意顺序摆放。
body.en: Compare each battery’s charge with the target and stop once it matches. The batteries can be in any order.

title.en: Check the middle of a sorted range

body.zh: 先把电池从低电量排到高电量。目标比中间电量大时，只需要找右边。目标比中间电量小时，只需要找左边。
body.en: Arrange the batteries from lowest to highest charge. If the target exceeds the middle charge, search the right side. If it is lower, search the left side.

prompt.zh: 电池从低电量到高电量排列。目标比中间的电量小，下一步去哪边找？
prompt.en: The batteries go from lowest to highest charge. The target is lower than the middle charge. Which side should you search next?

feedback.zh: 中间和右边的电量都已经大于目标，可以只找左边。
feedback.en: The middle and every battery on the right exceed the target, so only the left side is needed.
